notes.title: Updated to version 1.0.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added support for gamepad controls
[*] Improved the flow for unlocking optional levels
[*] Several minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Yugo Puzzle is part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase
notes.content: Yugo Puzzle is in the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase again this year! We are honored to be a part of it. [b]Yugo Puzzle is 20% off from now through August 10![/b]

notes.title: Text corrections
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Many parts of the French text have been revised and improved. Thank you Marin Taverniers-san for sending us the corrections!
[/list]

notes.title: Yugo Puzzle is part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase
notes.content: Yugo Puzzle is in the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase! We are honored to be a part of it. [b]Yugo Puzzle is 20% off from now through May 24 at 10 AM PDT![/b]

notes.title: Minor corrections
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Some minor corrections and improvements were made to hints, sounds, and text.
[/list]

notes.title: Added clue display feature
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added clue display feature. It helps you get through difficult levels where you are stuck.
[*]Corrected some texts.
[/list]

notes.title: Spanish and Korean languages added
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Spanish and Korean languages have been added.
[*] Corrected text in French and German.
[/list]

notes.title: Modified two levels and the grid behavior
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The solutions for level 11 have been reduced.
[*] Level 18 is now less difficult.
[*] The grid is now less likely to blend into the background grass.
[*] The grid now correctly follows window resizing.
[/list]

notes.title: Added a V-sync option and reduced CPU load
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added  a V-sync option
[*]Fixed a problem where the CPU load could increase significantly depending on the environment
[/list]
